purpose: Exercise nested INSERT/MINSERT callback fields and independently composed nested WCS transforms in the headless generated-DXF 3D consumer probe.
changes: Added runtime-authored child and parent blocks with nonzero block base points and a LINE in child-block coordinates.
Added a rotated, nonuniformly scaled 2x2 MINSERT in the parent block and an outer INSERT with mirrored/nonuniform scale and oblique OCS normal.

Checked distinct callback layers and selected INSERT/MINSERT insertion, extrusion, scale, rotation, array dimension/spacing, and child LINE fields in AC1027 ASCII and Binary DXF with ext=false and legacy ext=true.
Added a separate 4x4 matrix oracle for arbitrary-axis OCS, insertion, rotation, scale, and block-base translation; composed parent and child transforms and checked the nested WCS endpoints.
Checked that the OCS insertion-point and legacy WCS insertion-point representations yield equivalent composed endpoints.
scopeLimit: Generated same-library DXF callback and independent transform-model consistency evidence only. It does not qualify third-party DXF interoperability, DWG transform layouts, downstream MINSERT array expansion, or native consumer semantics.
fixturePolicy: DXF files are generated at runtime and removed; no drawing fixture file was added.
claimEffect: No support claim changes. The probe covers the selected nested INSERT/MINSERT callback fields and transform composition for this generated vector only.
